channel.title: Sea Technology magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sea Technology magazine (sea-technology.com)

item.title: High-Resolution Sub-Bottom Survey Reveals Hidden Histories in Sicily Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Genautics' Alfonso R. Analfino and Giuseppe Decaro and GeoAcoustics' Francisco J. Gutiérrez detail an archeological survey of Porto Empedocle, Sicily.

item.title: Marine Software Developer to Scale AI-Driven Fuel Saving Platform Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Swedish AI company Cetasol has raised $2.7m in a seed funding round to scale its AI-driven decision support and digital twin technology to reduce fuel use for ships.

item.title: Optical Sensors for Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement Research Pilot Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Kirby Simon of Sequoia Scientific, Dr. Dariia Atamanchuk of Dalhousie University and Dr. Will Burt of Planetary Tech discuss the role of optical sensors for an ocean alkalinity enhancement research pilot in Halifax, Canada.

item.title: Moving Vessel Profiler for Science Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Georgia Haydock of AML Oceanographic introduces an MVP designed for collecting high-density water column profiles continuously in real time, making it ideal for scientific applications.

item.title: World’s First Full-Scale CCS Deployment on a Seagoing Vessel Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Sigurd Jenssen of Wärtsilä Marine introduces onboard carbon capture and storage technology aboard Solvang ASA’s ethylene carrier Clipper Eris, designed to capture more than 70 percent of carbon dioxide from all onboard combustion sources.

item.title: How Hydrogen Technology Supports the Energy Transition Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Richard Colwill, Alexander Tancock and Warner Priest of InterContinental Energy describe the P2(H2)Node solution that offers a global, scalable, cost-efficient model for providing green molecules to the marine sector.

item.title: Treasures, Shipwrecks and the Dawn of Red Sea Diving Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Howard Rosenstein recounts his days of pioneering diving operations in the Red Sea.

item.title: Case Study: Coral Bleaching in Mauritius Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Dr. Anusha Devi Nawoor and Dr. Nora von Xylander of Tunley Environmental present a case study of coral bleaching in Mauritius, arguing that without addressing root causes, the survival of coral reefs worldwide remains at serious risk.

item.title: Farewell from Sea Technology Sea Technology magazine
item.description: Sea Technology will cease publication permanently.

item.title: Vietnam Marine & Offshore Expo, Nov. 19-21 Sea Technology magazine
item.description: VIMOX 2025 will feature a collaboration with Offshore Wind Vietnam Expo to drive innovation, foster business connections and promote the future of sustainable maritime technologies.
